title: The Tree of Hope initiation: 32 bars around four blocks
summary: Green explains the Hoofers fraternity's initiation of dancing 32 bars around four blocks to touch the Tree of Hope, and demonstrates 32 bars.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: Yeah, I would go on this tour, and I wandered as far down as the Hoofer's Club. I didn't know there was a Hoofer's Club at that time. I didn't know, and I had never seen much of Harlem, but 154th Street and up there around the Polo Grounds, you see, so I wandered down there and I found out that that's where there was some kind of dancers, tap dancers. They had a fraternity from the Hoofer's Club, and they had some kind of initiation going on. Where you would have to -- there was a tree called the Tree of Hope, and you wasn't allowed to stand under this tree unless you could dance by some kind of melody. And it wasn't considered a dance, a tap dance, unless you could dance -- tap dance -- 32 bars, which was a melody, of any song.
Chuck, I'd like you to demonstrate exactly what that is. Can you do that right now? Would you like to stand up, or can you do it sitting?

Well, here I am, about to demonstrate 32 bars of tap dancing, which is a melody, and that was the fraternity's initiation of the tap dancers who went in and were allowed to touch the Tree of Hope and go down into the Hoofer's Club. So I'll now demonstrate 32 bars of tap dancing.
See? That was 32 bars of tap dancing.

I can't find any words to tell you how sharp that is. I mean it's so much going on in your feet. I saw the cramps and all the different steps. I could practically see the history of tap dancing, just watching you in those 32 bars. How did it look to you, George?

That was a Charleston beat you finished up on, right? Great. So of course because of that, naturally they took you in. You became a member immediately at the Hoofer's Club. They opened the doors for you immediately and dragged you in.

See, now that's the initiation, like life. The Hoofer's Club's life, their fraternity, that was their life. And here comes a new recruit. They wouldn't allow you to touch the Tree of Hope unless you could tap dance by one chorus which is 32 bars of any music or song you preferred. And once you started you got to go around, you got to tap dance around four blocks. You tap danced from 7th Avenue, in front of the Hoofer's Club, down 131st Street to Lenox Avenue, then up Lenox Avenue to 132nd Street, and then up 132nd Street, Then, if you didn't miss any taps, they allowed you to touch the Tree of Hope.
